chapter.heading: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.
chapter.v:
May God
be merciful to us, bless us,and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

That your
way may be known on earth,and your salvation among all nations,

let the
peoples praise you, God.Let all the peoples praise you.

Oh let
the nations be glad and sing for joy,for you will judge the peoples with equity,and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

Let the
peoples praise you, God.Let all the peoples praise you.

The earth
has yielded its increase.God, even our own God, will bless us.

God will
bless us.All the ends of the earth shall fear him.
